title: Open sourced my SMC order block bot for MT5
author: BriefRecording3274

comments.author: QuanTradin
comments.body: one preset per market is where I'd look hardest. if the same logic needs different settings on every pair, the settings are carrying the results, and a preset tuned on the pair's own history is a fit, not a rule. the honest test is one preset across all of them and see what survives. locking the timeframes to three pairs was the right instinct, same thing for the rest of the knobs.

replies.author: BriefRecording3274
replies.body:
i got u bro ,the main rule is simple : It reads the higher timeframe for the level and the lower timeframe for the trigger:

Order Blocks are mapped on the HTF, the entry is confirmed by a CISD on the LTF.

the different in settings is the Timeframe pair ,Displacement ATR  and the time frame setups ,this EA is not optimezed once to avoid fitting or overfitting on certian symbole or history period.

replies.author: QuanTradin
replies.body: HTF level, LTF trigger, that part's clean. the bit I'd still poke at is the displacement ATR per pair. if that number moves with the pair it's doing the fitting quietly even when nothing was optimised. what happens if you run one pair's ATR setting on the other two?

replies.author: BriefRecording3274
replies.body: There is an **SMC\_1\_BestOverall** preset that works across all markets. However, to achieve greater precision, especially when using the EA on **metals, forex pairs, indices, and commodities**, it would be beneficial to optimize the settings for each asset class individually, as their liquidity, volatility, and trading characteristics differ significantly.

replies.author: QuanTradin
replies.body: per-asset presets are the part I'd test hardest, because a preset tuned on gold is a fit until it runs on gold data it never saw. tune on one year, run it on the next, per market, and count which presets survive. that split is what my thing, Quantradin (quantradin.com), does on paper for free, if you want somewhere to run all of them side by side.

replies.author: BriefRecording3274
replies.body: i will check it out thanks
